# Internal audit report

Audit date: 2026-09-15
Auditor: A support team member, independent of the area audited
Audit scope: Access reviews and change records

## Method

How evidence was gathered and sampled: Sampled ten access reviews and five changes

## Findings

1. Finding and where it was seen: Two access reviews were missed in the second quarter
2. Finding and where it was seen: One change had no recorded approval

## Observations

Improvement ideas that are not findings: Use a shared calendar for review reminders

## Follow-up

Who answers each finding and by when: Head of engineering, by 2026-10-31
